thread:
anika: Quick kickoff — need one compact copy pass for the website lanes (Hosted API / Dedicated capacity / Private). Goal: single page that splits by buyer intent and routes leads automatically.

matt: 👍 We should have one banner sentence that changes by URL param, then orbit into three short value bullets.

julie: Drafted a visual microcopy map. Will post Figma in a min. Thinking left-to-right: Fastest time-to-value (hosted), Predictable throughput (dedicated), Regulated & private (private).

saurav: For launch posts + webinar narrative we need consistent verbs. Suggest: "Ship faster", "Scale predictably", "Keep data private" — short verbs, actionable.

manika: @julie +1 on layout. Can we tighten the hero lines to 6–8 words each? Marketing goal: lower bounce, clearer CTA.

julie: dropping options:
```
Hosted: "Start generating in minutes — hosted API with curated models."
Dedicated: "Committed capacity for predictable latency and cost."
Private: "Deploy inside your VPC or air-gapped environment."
```

matt: I like the rhythm. For inbound routing, let's capture an extra hidden field per CTA: lane=hosted|dedicated|private so sales can triage. Add a microcopy tweak for the CTA: "Try hosted" vs "Request capacity" vs "Get private demo".

saurav: Webinar hook idea: "Benchmarks that map cost → latency for real apps" then 3 breakout tracks (onboarding with Hosted, throughput tuning on Dedicated, security & compliance on Private). Use landing copy to nudge registrants to pick a track.

anika: Nice. Also need 1 sentence that nudges self-serve vs sales: "Start for free" for hosted, "Contact sales for reserved pricing" for dedicated, "Enterprise deployment consult" for private. Keep consistent tone.

julie: Will make copy variants A/B friendly. Proposed short bullets under hero:
- Hosted: "Instant API, shared models, pay-as-you-go."
- Dedicated: "Dedicated GPUs, predictable throughput, SLAs."
- Private: "VPC control, KMS/HSM, compliance-ready."

matt: For launch posts: 2 short social lines + 1 benchmark stat. E.g. "We just launched Dedicated — 3x throughput consistency vs on-demand endpoints." Need to validate stat before publish.

saurav: I'll grab the bench numbers from eng-telemetry and annotate claims. Also prepping a one-pager for webinars that maps narratives to landing anchors.

anika: Action items: julie — upload Figma copy frames and build 2 A/B variants; matt — finalize CTA copy and routing keys; saurav — confirm benchmark stat and write webinar breakout descriptions. I'll coordinate dev to add hidden lane param and routing in HubSpot.

julie: Uploaded frames: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/landing-lanes-copy — check comments.

anika: thanks. quick note on tone: keep slightly technical but not jargon-heavy — target is product/infra folks and platform leads.

matt: timeline? we want social + blog + webinar in 2 weeks. Is that realistic?

saurav: If eng gives benchmark confirmation in 48h and design final by EOD tomorrow, yes.

anika: Cool. I'll set a 3pm sync tomorrow to lock variants. deploy-bot: deploy-preview created for /landing-lanes-copy (staging) — https://staging.redwood.ai/landing-lanes-copy (expires in 7 days).

julie: Preview looks good on mobile. Minor spacing tweak for hero bullets.

anika: Perfect. Meeting set. We'll iterate copy on the preview and lock for publish by the end of next week. :rocket:
